segments.text: I never asked to be queer
I never asked to live here
Now it's easy to live in fear
That the end of folks like me is near
I was such a good little Christian kid
At church up to five times per week I did
Always despising it when I backslid
Hating my sin I just wanted it red
How could so many things be demonic
They cause my extreme anxiety
Now it's chronic if Jesus was sinners
Was gladly platonic
How was that the result when they were sonic
Our faith was supposed to be different
Believing in life, love, truth, not belligerent
But because God made me intelligent
Now they see me as an evil insurgent
They warned me about going to university
That to stand for truth that faced great adversity
The enemy had filled that place with perversity
So I should tactfully manage my immersivity
I spoke up loudly in my religion classes
Me and my partner there looking like asses
So when that fool with those annoying glasses
Show me something new it took a few passes
If the Bible was the word of God and inerrant
How could it have contradictions so blatant
Even if small or from scribes incompetent
We were missing something it was transparent
We know enough to know one thing is fact
There are things that keep us from knowing as fact
What the entirety of scripture is it's not intact
So who is this God with whom we've made a pact
Something Yahweh emerged from other gods
That's a scary thought so what are the odds
Have you ever asked yourself if we're the frauds
These are the paths that philosophers tried
How do we know which ones are deceptive
We must judge sternly while being receptive
The sheep know his voice we must be perceptive
To what God says as he's being perceptive
Our enemies aren't flesh and blood but spirit
So why you fighting me I don't want to hear it
Salvation exclusive but we are to share it
Maybe we are just stochastic parrots
Now I'm the victim of a theocratic agenda
And all they can see is dangerous propaganda
But I'm not a freak of gross genderbenda
I'm the prophet rejected from my own land
